fields.description: File-level magic word 0xC0DEF3B4 framing EEPROM block 0 (raw bytes B4 F3 DE C0 at offset 4).
fields.evidence: FUN_08026aac / FUN_08026b5c transfer EEPROM in 8-byte blocks starting at address 0; raw file offset 4 holds bytes B4 F3 DE C0 (u32_le 0xC0DEF3B4), the only file-unique header word across all 64 blocks.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Primary 72-byte head of the 12-block level-progress payload (blocks 2-7). Byte-identical mirror at 0x158.
fields.evidence: Payload blocks read by FUN_08026aac (4x u16 per block into RAM struct, param_2+6 descending store) and written by FUN_08026b5c; range 0x10-0x57 is byte-identical to 0x158-0x19F, proving slot framing.
fields.name: slot0_grid_head

fields.description: Single-byte mutable state variable inside primary payload (value 1; slot1 counterpart at 0xF0 holds 9).
fields.evidence: Difflib content-alignment of slot payloads (FUN_08026aac block images at 0x10 and 0xB0) shows an aligned single-byte replace here: 0x01 vs 0x09, the only clean 1-byte state divergence; serialized via FUN_08026b5c block writes.
fields.name: slot0_state_value

fields.description: Primary 23-byte tail of the 12-block payload (blocks 7-13) after the state byte. Mirrored at 0x1A1.
fields.evidence: Continuation of the FUN_08026aac-readable payload after slot0_state_value; range 0x59-0x6F byte-identical to 0x1A1-0x1B7; compared by FUN_08026c38 verify loop semantics.
fields.name: slot0_grid_tail

fields.description: Primary-slot 32-bit trailer signature word (0x80FFFFFF) at footer block 18.
fields.evidence: Footer word read/written as one u32 unit by the FUN_08026aac / FUN_08026b5c 8-byte block primitives (block 18, first word); identical multiset in slot1 footer at 0x13C in swapped position.
fields.name: slot0_trailer_sig

fields.description: Primary-slot 32-bit trailer tag word (0x7F545515) at footer block 19.
fields.evidence: Second footer word of the FUN_08026b5c-written trailer (block 19, third word); same value appears as slot1 footer first word at 0x138.
fields.name: slot0_trailer_tag

fields.description: Primary-slot completion mark byte (0x54 = 84) at end of footer block 20.
fields.evidence: Trailing nonzero byte of the slot0 footer written via FUN_08026b5c (block 20 last byte); slot1 footer carries the same 0x54 mark at 0x143; nonzero sentinel position verified in baseline.
fields.name: slot0_completion_mark

fields.description: Second 64-byte head of the alternate-state 12-block payload (blocks 22-29). Same value multiset as slot0, rearranged state.
fields.evidence: Same-schema payload region serialized through FUN_08026aac / FUN_08026b5c block primitives; identical 14-value histogram to slot0 payload (16x00, 24x24, 23x49, 23x92, plus small ints) proves identical record schema with different arrangement.
fields.name: slot1_grid_head

fields.description: Single-byte mutable state variable inside alternate payload (value 9; primary counterpart at 0x58 holds 1).
fields.evidence: Content-aligned counterpart of slot0_state_value under difflib alignment of the two FUN_08026aac block images (0x10 vs 0xB0 regions): aligned replace 0x09 vs 0x01; writable via FUN_08026b5c block primitives.
fields.name: slot1_state_value

fields.evidence: Continuation of the slot1 payload after slot1_state_value under the FUN_08026aac block framing; same-schema bytes verified against baseline range 0xF1-0x10F.
fields.name: slot1_grid_tail

fields.description: Alternate-slot 32-bit trailer tag word (0x7F545515), first word of footer block 39.
fields.evidence: FUN_08026b5c-written trailer word; value-equals slot0_trailer_tag but stored first in this slot's footer, proving per-slot trailer layout.
fields.name: slot1_trailer_tag

fields.description: Alternate-slot 32-bit trailer signature word (0x80FFFFFF), second word of footer block 39.
fields.evidence: Value-equals slot0_trailer_sig (0x80FFFFFF) via the same FUN_08026aac block-read path; swapped word order vs slot0 footer verified in baseline.
fields.name: slot1_trailer_sig

fields.description: Alternate-slot completion mark byte (0x54 = 84) inside footer block 40.
fields.evidence: Same 0x54 sentinel value as slot0_completion_mark, carried at footer-relative position +11 (vs +23 in slot0); written through FUN_08026b5c block primitives.
fields.name: slot1_completion_mark

fields.description: Backup mirror of the primary 72-byte payload head (blocks 43-51). Byte-identical to 0x10-0x57.
fields.evidence: Byte-for-byte identical to slot0_grid_head (verified in Python over baseline); redundant copy compared with FUN_08026c38-style verify semantics and rewritten by FUN_08026b5c.
fields.name: slot0_grid_head_backup

fields.description: Backup mirror of the primary state byte (value 1, matches slot0_state_value).
fields.evidence: Byte-identical mirror of slot0_state_value at payload-relative +0x48 via the FUN_08026aac block framing; verified 0x01 in baseline at 0x1A0.
fields.name: slot0_state_value_backup

fields.description: Backup mirror of the primary 23-byte payload tail. Byte-identical to 0x59-0x6F.
fields.evidence: Byte-for-byte identical to slot0_grid_tail (verified in Python over baseline 0x1A1-0x1B7); redundant copy under FUN_08026b5c block writes.
fields.name: slot0_grid_tail_backup

magic_signatures.description: File magic B4 F3 DE C0 (u32_le 0xC0DEF3B4) framing EEPROM block 0
